events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51st
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a timeless message. John Lennon's 'Imagine' is 51 today.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Police, Sting, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting 75th
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, a true musical chameleon.

events.title: First iPod Released 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple launched its revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod 25th
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years since Apple put a thousand songs in your pocket.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: License to thrill: celebrating James Bond Day and over six decades of 007.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon 86th Tribute
angles.copy: A true visionary whose music continues to inspire generations. John Lennon would have been 86 today.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese 87th
angles.copy: From silly walks to hotel mayhem, a legend of British comedy turns 87 today. Happy birthday, John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as the "White Album," was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58th
angles.copy: An ambitious, eclectic masterpiece. The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58 years old today.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: The incomparable voice and showmanship of a true rock icon. Remembering Freddie Mercury today.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Turns 61
events.blurb: The groundbreaking Beatles album "Rubber Soul" was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61st
angles.copy: A pivotal album that marked a new era for The Beatles. 'Rubber Soul' is 61 today.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world. Remembering John Lennon today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th Tribute
angles.copy: The ever-evolving artist who redefined music, fashion, and culture. David Bowie would have been 80 today.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd Tribute
angles.copy: Still the King, generations later. Elvis Presley would have been 92 today.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page 83rd
angles.copy: The riff master and architect of some of rock's most iconic sounds. Happy 83rd birthday to Jimmy Page!

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The inimitable Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart 82nd
angles.copy: Still rocking and still got that unmistakable voice. Happy 82nd birthday to Rod Stewart!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: The charismatic frontman of Madness, Suggs, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs 66th
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The voice behind hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," Paul Young, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young 71st
angles.copy: From the Q-Tips to solo stardom, a smooth voice that defined an era. Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young!
